shortDescription: Formats an existing volume or a new volume on an existing partition on Windows

options.name: allocation_unit_size
options.description: Specifies the cluster size to use when formatting the volume. If no cluster size is specified when you format a partition, defaults are selected based on the size of the partition. This value must be a multiple of the physical sector size of the disk.

options.name: compress
options.description: Enable compression on the resulting NTFS volume. NTFS compression is not supported where I(allocation_unit_size) is more than 4096.

options.name: drive_letter
options.description: Used to specify the drive letter of the volume to be formatted.

options.name: file_system
options.description: Used to specify the file system to be used when formatting the target volume.

options.name: force
options.description: Specify if formatting should be forced for volumes that are not created from new partitions or if the source and target file system are different.

options.name: full
options.description: A full format writes to every sector of the disk, takes much longer to perform than the default (quick) format, and is not recommended on storage that is thinly provisioned. Specify C(true) for full format.

options.name: integrity_streams
options.description: Enable integrity streams on the resulting ReFS volume.

options.name: label
options.description: Used to specify the label of the volume to be formatted.

options.name: large_frs
options.description: Specifies that large File Record System (FRS) should be used.

options.name: new_label
options.description: Used to specify the new file system label of the formatted volume.

options.name: path
options.description: Used to specify the path to the volume to be formatted.
